from collections import defaultdict
from trend_meanrev_strategy.local.engine import TrendLegEngine, PARAMS
from trend_meanrev_strategy.local.data_loader import TrendMeanrevDataLoader

def analyze\(ov\):
    e = TrendLegEngine\(loader=TrendMeanrevDataLoader\(\), params=ov\)
    s = e.run\(\)
    comm, mc = PARAMS['commission'], PARAMS['min_commission']
    by_code = defaultdict\(list\)
    for o in s.orders: by_code[o.code].append\(o\)
    trades=[]
    for code, ods in by_code.items\(\):
        i=0
        while i<len\(ods\):
            if ods[i].side=='BUY' and i+1<len\(ods\) and ods[i+1].side=='SELL':
                b,se=ods[i],ods[i+1]
                trades.append\(\(se.value-max\(se.value*comm,mc\)\)-\(b.value+max\(b.value*comm,mc\)\)\)
                i+=2
            else: i+=1
    w=[t for t in trades if t>0]; tp=sum\(w\); tl=abs\(sum\(t for t in trades if t<=0\)\)
    return f'收益{s.total_return*100:+7.2f}% 回撤{s.max_drawdown*100:5.2f}% 胜率{len\(w\)/len\(trades\)*100:5.1f}% 盈亏比{tp/tl:5.2f} 买{s.buy_count}'

print\('基线:', analyze\({}\)\)
print\('[ROC周期\(排序口径\)]'\)
for v in \(10, 15, 20, 30, 60\):
    print\(f'  ROC{v}:', analyze\({'roc_period': v}\)\)
print\('[RSI周期\(防追高\)]'\)
for v in \(6, 9, 14, 21\):
    print\(f'  RSI{v}:', analyze\({'rsi_period': v}\)\)
print\('[ATR周期\(止损\)]'\)
for v in \(7, 10, 14, 21\):
    print\(f'  ATR{v}:', analyze\({'atr_period': v}\)\)
